note: Clock-coupling exemptions for scripts/check_clock_coupling.py. A test listed here pins a calendar constant AND exercises a rolling *_DAYS window; each entry must also carry a '# clock-coupled: <mitigation>' marker in the test file itself. See ADR 0060.

exempt.test_parity_query.py: Reviewed: every parity_query call in the file injects now=NOW (parse -> parse_query, and game_matches_query), so the pinned 2026 literals in FIXTURES are derived from that injected clock, not the wall clock. parity_query falls back to datetime.now() only when a caller omits now, which no case does.
exempt.test_parity_radio.py: Fixed in 71d75ec: the fixture is materialized against the current time instead of a pinned 2026-09-12, so the constant no longer decides reuse.
